title: Hippocrates Raw Hummus

content:
4 cups sprouted chick peas

1 cup olive oil

3 cloves garlic

6 oz lemon juice

1 T Braggs (or to taste)

1 T kelp powder

1 t Frontier Pizza Seasoning

1 pinch cayenne

2 t ground cumin seed

Combine all ingredients in a blender. Season to taste.
